title: Mock-Trap Evidence Report
description: Output of scripts/iterate/iterate_audit.py, consumed by /iterate-test (Step-4b verification rail) and /triage. Verifies the DETERMINISTIC half of /iterate-test: which imported production symbols a Python test mocks vs calls un-patched, and canned-value assertion tautologies. The signal is ONE-DIRECTIONAL: a MOCK_TRAP_CANDIDATE means an imported production symbol is mocked, but the engine does NOT decide whether it is the PRIMARY intelligence under test (a Mock Trap) or INFRASTRUCTURE (a valid mock) — that is the agent's Step-4b judgment. A clean scan (NO_FINDINGS) is NEVER a fidelity certification. Reading a clean scan as a HOT pass is the Mock Trap this engine surfaces. Python-first: the AST analysis is exact for Python only.

workspace.description: Resolved absolute path to the scanned workspace.

subject.description: The production module/symbol the test claims to validate (--subject), or null.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the analyzed test file.

parse_error.description: True if the file could not be parsed as Python.

production_candidates.description: Imports that are NOT test infrastructure — candidate subjects/dependencies.

test_infra.description: Imports of unittest/mock/pytest and related scaffolding.

func.description: Dotted name of the patch-like callable.

target.description: The literal patch-target string, or null if not a string literal.

canned_output.description: True if constructed with a literal return_value/side_effect.

symbols.description: Per imported production candidate: is it mocked, and how often is it called?

name.description: Local binding name in the test.

patched.description: True if a patch target matches this symbol — its behavior is replaced by a mock.

call_count.description: Number of calls whose callee root is this symbol.

fidelity.description: MOCK_TRAP_CANDIDATE = imported + mocked (PRIMARY/INFRASTRUCTURE is the agent's call). CALLED_LIVE = imported + called un-patched (NOT a certification). IMPORTED_UNUSED = imported, neither mocked nor called.

hardcoded_assertions.description: A mock's canned return_value/side_effect literal echoed in an assertion (Step-4g / RULE-10 deficiency). Advisory, one-directional.

file_signal.description: ONE-DIRECTIONAL. A finding lowers confidence; LIVE/NO_FINDINGS certifies NOTHING about fidelity. The HOT/MOCKED verdict and PRIMARY/INFRASTRUCTURE classification stay the agent's (Step 4b).

signal_basis.description: Human explanation of the file signal.

verdict_hint.description: ADVISORY. FINDINGS = >=1 mock-trap candidate or hardcoded-assertion file. NO_FINDINGS = none detected — explicitly NOT a fidelity certification.
